source: Quiz 4 - Sessions 1-5: Building and Improving Agent Skills
question: A commercial model gives a better answer after spending longer on a problem. You know research models can use hidden recurrence. What can you conclude about this commercial model?

options.text: It uses the same recurrent block as the published research model.
options.feedback: Similar behavior does not establish identical internals. A published research architecture is evidence about that research system.

options.text: It added new independent parameters while working on this request.
options.feedback: More inference time does not establish a larger parameter set. Existing weights can support additional computation.

options.text: Its printed explanation fully specifies the hidden numerical process.
options.feedback: A written explanation is not a complete record of internal vector operations. It does not disclose the architecture merely by describing an answer.

options.text: Its architecture remains uncertain from that behavior alone.
options.feedback: Longer processing and a better answer are observations of behavior. They do not identify the undisclosed mechanism that produced the result.
